segments.text: 45 Where thou ſaweſt that the ſtone was cut out of the mountayne without handes, and that it brake in peeces, the yron, the braſſe, the clay, the ſiluer and the golde: ſo the great God hath ſhewed the king what ſhall come to paſſe hereafter, and the dreame is true, and the interpretation thereof is ſure.
